snippet.title: "Into the Unknown" | Alpha Level 1 Gameplay Reveal (UE5 indie FPS)
snippet.description:
Here is the full alpha playthrough of the first level of the game I'm working on. The game will be in the style of *Black Mesa* and *Half-Life*, with an engaging story and many different levels, varying in length from just a few seconds to several hours.

• Devlog #1 – https://youtu.be/KdJTqHRj_kg
• Devlog #2 - https://youtu.be/VPH8EtjPwO0
